university.name: London Metropolitan University
university.summary: London Metropolitan University has campuses at Aldgate, Holloway and Shoreditch in London. Its International Study Centre runs a foundation programme, an International Year One and a Pre-Master's programme for international students. Its Pakistan page sets out undergraduate and postgraduate entry routes and a South Asia scholarship.

courses.title: International Foundation Programme
courses.duration_text: One academic year of foundation study, followed by the degree on a single integrated visa
courses.overview: A one-year foundation programme run through the London Met International Study Centre with Business, Computer Science and Health pathways, leading into London Met degrees. Later years are charged at the standard international rate for the chosen degree.
highlights: Business pathway: English for Academic Purposes and Professional Communication
Business pathway: Academic and Study Skills for Business
Business pathway: Applied Numeracy and Data for Business
courses.academic_requirements: Five GCSE or IGCSE subjects at grade 4 or equivalent. Each application is assessed individually. Minimum age: 17 by 31 December of the start year for a September start; 17 for January and May starts.
courses.english_requirements: Academic IELTS 5.5 overall with no component below 5.5, or an equivalent qualification.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The ISC page lists no Pakistan grades and refers to a country-specific PDF that could not be opened. The London Met Pakistan page separately states, for a four-year degree with a foundation year, 'Second division (65% plus) in Intermediate Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSCC) or Federal Secondary Certificate (FSC)', or a Diploma of Associate Engineer with minimum grade 75%. It was not confirmed that this refers to this programme, so no structured Pakistan fields are set.
courses.notes: The page states a GBP 19,500 fee for the foundation year, with scholarships of up to GBP 6,000, but does not name the academic year, so tuition_academic_year is null. Business is shown as the field because it is listed first; the programme also has Computer Science and Health pathways. The page says the programme specification is awaiting validation and the programme is subject to regulatory approval.

courses.title: International Year One
courses.overview: A one-year programme at the Holloway campus with Business and Computer Science pathways, for applicants with three A Levels or equivalent, a recognised foundation programme or a good first year of an overseas degree. It leads into listed London Met degrees.
highlights: Business pathway: Introduction to Business Management
Business pathway: Analytical Skills and Business Environments
Computer Science pathway: Programming and Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals
Computer Science pathway: Systems Architecture, Networking and Operating Systems
courses.academic_requirements: Three A Levels (or equivalent), or a recognised foundation programme, or the first year of an overseas degree with good grades. Each application is assessed individually. Minimum age: 17 by 31 December of the start year for a September start; 17 for January and May starts.
courses.english_requirements: Academic IELTS 5.5 overall with no component below 5.5, or an equivalent qualification.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The page refers to a country-specific PDF for academic entry requirements and lists nothing for Pakistan.
courses.notes: The page states a GBP 19,500 fee, with scholarships of up to GBP 6,000, but does not name the academic year. The page says the programme specification is awaiting validation and the programme is subject to regulatory approval. A GBP 5,000 per year Bright Futures Scholarship is stated for students who progress to Year 2 at London Met.

courses.title: Pre-Master's Programme
courses.overview: A one or two term programme at the London Met International Study Centre for graduates of a relevant three-year degree. It leads into a listed London Met Master's in business, computing, health and other areas.
highlights: Critical Thinking and Research Foundations (both routes)
Academic English and Communication Skills (both routes)
Advanced Research Methods and Data Analysis (two-term route)
courses.academic_requirements: A 3-year degree in an area relevant to the Master's degree, or equivalent. Each applicant is assessed individually. Minimum age: 17 before the course starts.
courses.english_requirements: Academic IELTS 5.5 overall with no component below 5.5, or an equivalent qualification.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The page refers to a country-specific PDF and lists no Pakistan or degree grade requirements.
courses.application_deadline_note: May 2027 intake is one term only.
courses.notes: Fee is GBP 12,500 for 1 term or GBP 14,000 for 2 terms, with scholarships of up to GBP 2,500; the page does not name the academic year. Term length in months is not stated, so duration_months is null. Business is shown as the field because the page lists many progression Master's degrees across fields. The page says duration is subject to regulatory approval.

scholarships.name: South Asia Bright Futures Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 tuition fee reduction for the duration of studies (Pakistan page)
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction applied automatically to eligible Pakistani students with overseas fee status who start a degree in January 2027 or May 2027, at undergraduate or postgraduate level.
scholarships.criteria_text: Pakistani students with overseas fee status starting a degree at London Met in January 2027 or May 2027.
scholarships.notes: The scholarships overview page lists the award as a partial tuition fee reduction for Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka without an amount. The dedicated award page was not opened (the fetch was refused), so exclusions, the number of years and how it combines with the International Bright Futures Scholarship are unconfirmed. value_basis is null because the page says only 'for the duration of your studies'.

scholarships.name: International Bright Futures Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction applied automatically by the Admissions team to new international fee-paying students on full-time, full-degree programmes at London campuses who start in 2026/27. Several course types are excluded.
scholarships.criteria_text: New international fee-paying student with an offer for a full-time, full-degree programme at London Met's UK campuses starting in 2026/27. Excludes distance learning, partner-institution courses and listed courses such as PG Certificates and Diplomas.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: Terms are for 2026/27 only; 2027/28 terms were not found, so September 2027 entry is unconfirmed. The page introduction says '2025/27', which conflicts with the 2026/27 criteria. For one course the award is split GBP 2,500 per year over two years, which is why value_basis is total. The page says it cannot be combined with other London Met scholarships except the Prompt Payment Discount; whether a South Asia Bright Futures award replaces it for Pakistani students is not stated.

scholarships.name: Early Payment Discount (Prompt Payment Discount)
scholarships.value_text: Up to 5% off tuition, applied after scholarship reductions
scholarships.summary: A tuition reduction of up to 5% for new international fee-paying students who pay the remaining tuition balance as part of their deposit by the stated deadline. No application is needed.
scholarships.criteria_text: New international fee-paying students on full-time, full-degree programmes at London campuses starting in 2026/27 who pay in full by the deadline. Excludes PG Certificates, PG Diplomas, apprenticeships and several named courses.
scholarships.deadline_note: The page states full tuition must be received on or before 6 August 2026 (a 2026/27 deadline); deadlines for January 2027, May 2027 or 2027/28 starts are not stated.
scholarships.notes: Terms are for 2026/27 only. The page says it can be combined with the International Bright Futures Scholarship but not with the EU, Norway, Switzerland, USA, Canada or Latin America Bright Futures awards; South Asia is not mentioned. Deferring an offer may remove the discount.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate alumni discount
scholarships.value_text: Up to 20% off postgraduate tuition for London Met graduates
scholarships.summary: A discount of up to 20% on postgraduate study for London Met graduates, stated to apply to home, EU and international graduates. A course page notes exclusions.
scholarships.criteria_text: Graduates of London Met studying a further postgraduate course.
scholarships.notes: The page gives no eligibility detail, exclusions list, route or year. Only relevant to Pakistani applicants who already hold a London Met degree.

Undergraduate and other postgraduate degrees: international fee not displayed on the pages reached.

Country awards for Canada, USA, Norway, Switzerland, East Asia, Latin America, EU and UK citizens: not open to Pakistani or UK-resident applicants as stated.
